readings: For each film `rating`, count the inventory copies (every inventory record, matched to its film). Which ratings have more copies than the average of these counts across all ratings? Give one row with the total number of copies across those above-average ratings and the average amount by which their counts exceed the across-rating average, unrounded.
queries:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
avg_c AS (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) AS a FROM counts
)
SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_copies, AVG(cnt - a) AS avg_excess
FROM counts, avg_c
WHERE cnt > a;
